name: pre-pr-qa-toolkit
description: Verified browser recordings, timecoded findings, pre-PR audits, and safe CityCatalyst demos with CC/CA error evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Record and audit real browser flows before a PR.
interface.longDescription: Record verified browser walkthroughs with timecoded evidence and structured reports, run critical user-centered feature audits, add an optional independent Expect pass, and record the safe CityCatalyst inventory demo with CC and Climate Advisor runtime-error evidence.
defaultPrompt: Critically audit this branch as a user before its PR.
Record a browser walkthrough and report what breaks.
Record the safe CityCatalyst inventory demo and report all available CC and Climate Advisor runtime errors.
